resumen: Sanctuary raid for 10 players. It opens with the Central Abyss Fusion Reactor, continues with one mid-boss per party (Rahu or Ketu) and ends with both parties together against Eternal Ludra.

reglas.texto: Each entry has a 60-minute limit for all bosses: that was the case in all 10 recorded entries.
In all our entries the order was the same: the Reactor first, then the mid-boss and Ludra last.

composicion.texto: Two parties of 5. Each one takes one of the mid-bosses: in our entries, the recording player did Rahu 9 times and Ketu once, and never both in the same entry.
Guides agree on the core of each party: a Templar to tank, a Cleric to heal and a Chanter for support; the rest, damage.

notas.texto: That dungeon 600082 is Normal mode is an inference: our entries include players with 2823 gear score, below the 3000 that guides give for Hard. Nobody in the group has entered 600083 yet.
